PINN.N_formula.statement:
PINN.N_formula : ∀ (t : ℝ),
  PINN.N t =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 32,
        ↑(PINN.NetW.W3.getD j 0) / 65536 *
          Real.tanh
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 32,
                ↑((PINN.NetW.W2.getD j []).getD i 0) / 65536 *
                  Real.tanh (↑(PINN.NetW.W1.getD i 0) / 65536 * t + ↑(PINN.NetW.b1.getD i 0) / 65536) +
              ↑(PINN.NetW.b2.getD j 0) / 65536) +
      ↑PINN.NetW.b3 / 65536
'PINN.N_formula'

PINN.Nh_formula.statement:
PINN.Nh_formula : ∀ (t : ℝ),
  PINN.Nh t =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 32,
        ↑(PINN.NetH.W3.getD j 0) / 65536 *
          Real.tanh
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 32,
                ↑((PINN.NetH.W2.getD j []).getD i 0) / 65536 *
                  Real.tanh (↑(PINN.NetH.W1.getD i 0) / 65536 * t + ↑(PINN.NetH.b1.getD i 0) / 65536) +
              ↑(PINN.NetH.b2.getD j 0) / 65536) +
      ↑PINN.NetH.b3 / 65536
'PINN.Nh_formula'

PINN.uhat_formula.statement:
PINN.uhat_formula : ∀ (t : ℝ), PINN.uhat t = 1 + t * PINN.Nh t
'PINN.uhat_formula'

PINN.shapes.statement:
PINN.shapes : (PINN.NetW.W1.length = 32 ∧
    PINN.NetW.b1.length = 32 ∧
      PINN.NetW.W2.length = 32 ∧
        PINN.NetW.b2.length = 32 ∧ PINN.NetW.W3.length = 32 ∧ ∀ j < 32, (PINN.NetW.W2.getD j []).length = 32) ∧
  PINN.NetH.W1.length = 32 ∧
    PINN.NetH.b1.length = 32 ∧
      PINN.NetH.W2.length = 32 ∧
        PINN.NetH.b2.length = 32 ∧ PINN.NetH.W3.length = 32 ∧ ∀ j < 32, (PINN.NetH.W2.getD j []).length = 32
'PINN.shapes'

PINN.part1.statement:
PINN.part1 : ∀ (M : ℝ → ℝ),
  PINN.C1On M →
    ∀ (K : ℕ) (a lo hi : ℕ → ℝ),
      PINN.Bounds M K a lo hi →
        ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ),
          PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, PINN.lowerB M K a hi t ≤ u t - M t ∧ u t - M t ≤ PINN.upperB M K a lo t
'PINN.part1'

PINN.part1_explicit.statement:
PINN.part1_explicit : ∀ (M M' : ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, HasDerivWithinAt M (M' t) (Set.Icc 0 4) t) →
    ContinuousOn M' (Set.Icc 0 4) →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (a lo hi : ℕ → ℝ),
        a 0 = 0 →
          a K = 4 →
            (∀ k < K, a k < a (k + 1)) →
              (∀ k < K, lo k ≤ hi k) →
                (∀ k < K,
                    ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (a k) (a (k + 1)),
                      lo k ≤ M' s + M s - Real.exp (-s) ∧ M' s + M s - Real.exp (-s) ≤ hi k) →
                  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ),
                    PINN.IsSolution u →
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, PINN.lowerB M K a hi t ≤ u t - M t ∧ u t - M t ≤ PINN.upperB M K a lo t
'PINN.part1_explicit'

PINN.part1_contDiffOn.statement:
PINN.part1_contDiffOn : ∀ (M : ℝ → ℝ),
  ContDiffOn ℝ 1 M (Set.Icc 0 4) →
    ∀ (K : ℕ) (a lo hi : ℕ → ℝ),
      PINN.Bounds M K a lo hi →
        ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ),
          PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, PINN.lowerB M K a hi t ≤ u t - M t ∧ u t - M t ≤ PINN.upperB M K a lo t
'PINN.part1_contDiffOn'

PINN.residual_route.statement:
PINN.residual_route : ∀ (M : ℝ → ℝ),
  PINN.C1On M →
    ∀ (ε : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (a lo hi : ℕ → ℝ),
      PINN.Bounds M K a lo hi →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, -ε ≤ PINN.lowerB M K a hi t ∧ PINN.upperB M K a lo t ≤ ε) →
          ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - M t| ≤ ε
'PINN.residual_route'

PINN.cert_numbers.statement:
PINN.cert_numbers : ∀ (L : List PINN.Piece) (k : ℕ),
  PINN.ca L k = ↑(L.getD k PINN.dflt).1 / 2 ^ 20 ∧
    PINN.clo L k = ↑(L.getD k PINN.dflt).2.2.1 / 2 ^ 64 ∧ PINN.chi L k = ↑(L.getD k PINN.dflt).2.2.2 / 2 ^ 64
'PINN.cert_numbers'

PINN.part2_named.statement:
PINN.part2_named : PINN.certN.length = 508 ∧
  PINN.Bounds PINN.N 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.clo PINN.certN) (PINN.chi PINN.certN) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
      -(2 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.N 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.chi PINN.certN) t ∧
        PINN.upperB PINN.N 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.clo PINN.certN) t ≤ 2 / 10000
'PINN.part2_named'

PINN.part3_named.statement:
PINN.part3_named : PINN.certH.length = 652 ∧
  PINN.Bounds PINN.uhat 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.clo PINN.certH) (PINN.chi PINN.certH) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
      -(3 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.uhat 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.chi PINN.certH) t ∧
        PINN.upperB PINN.uhat 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.clo PINN.certH) t ≤ 3 / 10000
'PINN.part3_named'

PINN.transfer_N.statement:
PINN.transfer_N : ∀ (M : ℝ → ℝ),
  PINN.C1On M →
    M 0 = PINN.N 0 →
      (∀ k < 508,
          ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (PINN.ca PINN.certN k) (PINN.ca PINN.certN (k + 1)),
            PINN.clo PINN.certN k ≤ derivWithin M (Set.Icc 0 4) s + M s - Real.exp (-s) ∧
              derivWithin M (Set.Icc 0 4) s + M s - Real.exp (-s) ≤ PINN.chi PINN.certN k) →
        PINN.Bounds M 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.clo PINN.certN) (PINN.chi PINN.certN) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
              -(2 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB M 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.chi PINN.certN) t ∧
                PINN.upperB M 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.clo PINN.certN) t ≤ 2 / 10000) ∧
            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - M t| ≤ 2 / 10000
'PINN.transfer_N'

PINN.transfer_H.statement:
PINN.transfer_H : ∀ (M : ℝ → ℝ),
  PINN.C1On M →
    M 0 = 1 →
      (∀ k < 652,
          ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (PINN.ca PINN.certH k) (PINN.ca PINN.certH (k + 1)),
            PINN.clo PINN.certH k ≤ derivWithin M (Set.Icc 0 4) s + M s - Real.exp (-s) ∧
              derivWithin M (Set.Icc 0 4) s + M s - Real.exp (-s) ≤ PINN.chi PINN.certH k) →
        PINN.Bounds M 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.clo PINN.certH) (PINN.chi PINN.certH) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
              -(3 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB M 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.chi PINN.certH) t ∧
                PINN.upperB M 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.clo PINN.certH) t ≤ 3 / 10000) ∧
            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - M t| ≤ 3 / 10000
'PINN.transfer_H'

PINN.part2.statement:
PINN.part2 : (∃ K a lo hi,
    PINN.Bounds PINN.N K a lo hi ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, -(2 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.N K a hi t ∧ PINN.upperB PINN.N K a lo t ≤ 2 / 10000) ∧
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - PINN.N t| ≤ 2 / 10000
'PINN.part2'

PINN.part3.statement:
PINN.part3 : (∃ K a lo hi,
    PINN.Bounds PINN.uhat K a lo hi ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, -(3 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.uhat K a hi t ∧ PINN.upperB PINN.uhat K a lo t ≤ 3 / 10000) ∧
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - PINN.uhat t| ≤ 3 / 10000
'PINN.part3'

PINN.solution_exists.statement:
PINN.solution_exists : PINN.IsSolution fun t => (1 + t) * Real.exp (-t)
'PINN.solution_exists'

PINN.main.statement:
PINN.main : (∀ (M : ℝ → ℝ),
    PINN.C1On M →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (a lo hi : ℕ → ℝ),
        PINN.Bounds M K a lo hi →
          ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ),
            PINN.IsSolution u →
              ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, PINN.lowerB M K a hi t ≤ u t - M t ∧ u t - M t ≤ PINN.upperB M K a lo t) ∧
  ((∃ K a lo hi,
        PINN.Bounds PINN.N K a lo hi ∧
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, -(2 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.N K a hi t ∧ PINN.upperB PINN.N K a lo t ≤ 2 / 10000) ∧
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - PINN.N t| ≤ 2 / 10000) ∧
    ((∃ K a lo hi,
          PINN.Bounds PINN.uhat K a lo hi ∧
            ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
              -(3 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.uhat K a hi t ∧ PINN.upperB PINN.uhat K a lo t ≤ 3 / 10000) ∧
        ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), PINN.IsSolution u → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4, |u t - PINN.uhat t| ≤ 3 / 10000) ∧
      (PINN.Bounds PINN.N 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.clo PINN.certN) (PINN.chi PINN.certN) ∧
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
            -(2 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.N 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.chi PINN.certN) t ∧
              PINN.upperB PINN.N 508 (PINN.ca PINN.certN) (PINN.clo PINN.certN) t ≤ 2 / 10000) ∧
        PINN.Bounds PINN.uhat 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.clo PINN.certH) (PINN.chi PINN.certH) ∧
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 4,
            -(3 / 10000) ≤ PINN.lowerB PINN.uhat 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.chi PINN.certH) t ∧
              PINN.upperB PINN.uhat 652 (PINN.ca PINN.certH) (PINN.clo PINN.certH) t ≤ 3 / 10000
'PINN.main'
